title: Besu production (QBFT)
description: Validators and RPC nodes of the production QBFT network

panels.title: Critical firing
panels.description: Critical alerts firing now (all components). Details in the table and on Prometheus's Alerts page.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Every alert firing now, critical first. 'Firing for' counts from when the condition started (including the rule's wait time). Full text: Prometheus -> Alerts.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity, subject) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="critical"} * 3 or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="warning"} * 2 or ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}), "subject", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "host", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "address", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "sender", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "node", "(.+)"))

max by (alertname, severity, subject) ((time() - label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(ALERTS_FOR_STATE, "subject", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "host", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "address", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "sender", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "node", "(.+)")) and on(alertname, severity, subject) label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}, "subject", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "host", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "address", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "sender", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "node", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Seconds since last block
panels.description: Red when no block for 3 x the block period: fewer than the quorum of validators is online.

panels.title: Validators up
panels.description: QBFT needs ceil(2n/3) validators online to produce blocks (4 validators: 3).

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: One row per Besu node. Peers should be (number of nodes - 1). Sync: IN SYNC; SYNCING (the node says so); STALLED (says in sync but its newest block is over 60 s old while other nodes are current: it stopped importing); BEHIND (more than 30 blocks below the highest node and its newest block over 30 s old). Behind: blocks below the highest node; up to ~15 is normal, because Prometheus reads the nodes a few seconds apart.

targets.expr: (max by (node, role, instance) (besu_synchronizer_in_sync{job="besu",node=~"$node"}) == 0) or ((max by (node, role, instance) (besu_synchronizer_in_sync{job="besu",node=~"$node"}) * 0 + 2) and (max by (node, role, instance) (timestamp(besu_blockchain_chain_head_timestamp{job="besu",node=~"$node"}) - besu_blockchain_chain_head_timestamp{job="besu",node=~"$node"}) > 60) and on() (min(timestamp(besu_blockchain_chain_head_timestamp{job="besu"}) - besu_blockchain_chain_head_timestamp{job="besu"}) < 30)) or ((max by (node, role, instance) (besu_synchronizer_in_sync{job="besu",node=~"$node"}) * 0 + 3) and ((scalar(max(ethereum_blockchain_height{job="besu"})) - max by (node, role, instance) (ethereum_blockchain_height{job="besu",node=~"$node"})) > 30) and (max by (node, role, instance) (timestamp(besu_blockchain_chain_head_timestamp{job="besu",node=~"$node"}) - besu_blockchain_chain_head_timestamp{job="besu",node=~"$node"}) > 30)) or (max by (node, role, instance) (besu_synchronizer_in_sync{job="besu",node=~"$node"}) * 0 + 1)

panels.title: Seconds since last block
panels.description: Age of the node's newest block when it was scraped. Stays below about 1 block period when healthy.

panels.title: Transaction pool
panels.description: Pending transactions. Steady growth means blocks are not keeping up or nonces have gaps.

panels.title: Transactions in selected range
panels.description: Transactions mined during the time range selected at the top of the dashboard: the exact differences of Besu's transaction counter, minute by minute (may include up to 1 minute before the range). For permanent exact totals, see chainlens.

panels.title: Last 24 hours
panels.description: Needs 24 h of Prometheus history; less is counted until then.

panels.title: Transactions per interval
panels.description: Transactions mined per bar. The bar width follows the zoom: 1 minute at most, wider for long ranges (the 'Interval' shown when hovering the panel's info).

panels.title: Cumulative transactions in range
panels.description: Running total from the start of the selected range.

panels.title: Refused connections (node allowlist)
panels.description: Connection attempts from nodes not in permissions_config.toml.

panels.title: Senders (proxy)
panels.description: Per sender of the proxy. Mined = STALLED: transactions are ready in the RPC node's pool but blocks do not include them (restart one validator). Nonce gap: a missing nonce blocks later transactions; the proxy repairs it once the chain moved on for 30 s / 10 blocks.

panels.title: Transactions in flight (proxy)
panels.description: Sent by the proxy, not confirmed yet. Should fall back to ~0 after a burst.

panels.title: Not mined / gap (seconds)
panels.description: How long ready transactions have waited with nothing confirmed, and how long a nonce gap has existed.
